description: This file contains C source code implementing version management and installation routines for an RDM (Remote Device Management) application. It manages app version verification, installation, uninstallation, and final version determination, primarily for a download or update process.

methods.name: INT32 rdmDwnlVAVerifyApp(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet,CHAR * pVer)
methods.description: Validates the app version against some criteria using rdmDwnlValidation and logs an error if validation fails.

methods.name: VOID rdmDwnlVAGetInstallVer(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet,CHAR ** ppVer,INT32 * pInum,CHAR ** ppUver,INT32 * pUnum)
methods.description: Retrieves installed app versions from package files, verifies them, and manages older versions for potential removal.

methods.name: INT32 rdmDwnlVAGetManifetVer(CHAR * pkgVersion,CHAR ** ppVer)
methods.description: Parses the package version string to extract individual version entries.

methods.name: INT32 rdmDwnlVACheckList(CHAR ** ppVer,CHAR * pVerify,INT32 num_ver)
methods.description: Checks if a specified version is in the list of verified versions.

methods.name: VOID rdmDwnlVAGetFinalVer(CHAR ** ppJver,INT32 jnum,CHAR ** ppIver,INT32 inum,CHAR ** ppFver,INT32 * pFnum,CHAR ** ppUver,INT32 * pUnum)
methods.description: Combines versions from manifest and installed sets, determining final versions for installation and removal, removing duplicates and outdated entries.

methods.name: VOID rdmDwnlVAUnInstall(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet,CHAR ** ppVer,INT32 num_ver)
methods.description: Uninstalls specified app versions by calling uninstall routines and removing related files.

methods.name: INT32 rdmDwnlVAInstall(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet,CHAR ** ppVer,INT32 num_ver)
methods.description: Installs specified app versions, setting up paths and calling download management routines.

methods.name: VOID rdmDwnlVAGetDetails(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet,CHAR ** ppJver,INT32 * pJnum,CHAR ** ppIver,INT32 * pInum,CHAR ** ppFver,INT32 * pFnum,CHAR ** ppUver,INT32 * pUnum)
methods.description: Coordinates retrieval of version info from manifest, installed, and final sets.

methods.name: INT32 rdmDownloadVerApp(RDMAPPDetails * pRdmAppDet)
methods.description: Main function invoked to update app versions: retrieves version info, uninstalls old versions, installs new ones.
